ruleReferences.usedFor: Official Pikachu Overwriting Bolt: 10 damage, Lightning Weakness x2 until end of next own turn.

Attack damage precedes other effects; Weakness is calculated at step 3, while ignoring defender effects skips step 5 (B-07). Bench/evolution removes attack effects. Applying the live x3 aura after the changed Weakness is an implementation inference from these separate type and multiplier effects.
